dossier.bear_case: The top three holdings are 45% of the fund. A bad quarter for any one of them moves FTEC far more than the S&P 500, and it overlaps a third with the core fund.
dossier.changes_since_last: Top three weight is up 2 points since the June holdings.

sources.title: Your note: keep the tilt at 20%, no higher

dossier.thesis: FTEC is the plan's tech tilt at 20% of the mix. It tracks the broad US tech index for 0.084% a year, and the plan already caps it so one sector can't run the portfolio.
dossier.what_would_change:
Top three weights pass 50%.
Forward P/E above 35x.
The plan drops the tech tilt.
